career_survey_entry.speaker: narrator
career_survey_entry.text: Yue returned to the dry terrace carrying the watershed office's accepted training offer. The word trainee looked small beside her fifth-stage cord. She had measured channels, helped read caravan roads and worked a crossing bench; she had never held a survey appointment of her own. Across the rail, a closed bridge retained its barricades. The office wanted observations along the accessible upper drainage walk before it planned ordinary maintenance. It wanted a recorder who would distinguish what she saw from what everyone hoped those observations could secure.

career_survey_contract_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_contract_01.text: Yuan Lian laid out three field-shift tickets, each worth four copper to Yue upon completing its agreed hours. Yuan's mill had arranged a relief forewoman for those specific mornings; the keys remained under their ordinary handover. Her operating experience qualified her to supervise these channel observations. Jiang Tao would examine Yue's recording afterward without having directed her field answers. Yuan tapped the first ticket. 'Your earlier experience matters. It lets us start with real work. It does not let me pretend you have already finished this training.'

career_survey_contract_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_contract_02.text: The watershed office had deposited thirty copper from its ordinary maintenance training account. Twelve paid Yue's three shifts; six paid Yuan's supervision; three paid Jiang's independent practical review; two paid an attending local witness. Four covered purchased recording cloth and the equipment carrier. The remaining three funded one later specialist assignment after qualification. Its recipient would be Yue only if she completed that assignment. The earlier crossing's emergency and recovery purses were closed accounts. This new deposit could hire observations without buying a repaired bridge, replacement freight or a clinical judgment.

career_survey_contract_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_contract_03.text: Yue asked what happened if she failed. The contract paid completed supervised hours, including honest failed observations and their correction within the reserved shifts. Jiang's review fee stayed the same for a refusal or a pass. Qualification required usable records and a witnessed practical check; wages required performed work. She read those two conditions until they no longer sounded like opposite kinds of kindness. Yuan added that anyone could withdraw before a new shift. A withdrawn shift would leave its unused wage with the office, without taking back hours already paid.

career_survey_contract_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_contract_04.text: She signed as an experienced measurement assistant entering recorder training. The earlier flood account stayed in its own cover, including the chosen cargo and later recovery service. A farmer waiting by the rail asked whether this commission would make the bridge usable. Yuan answered before Yue could arrange a comforting sentence: the bridge needed its separate structural examiner. The farmer turned away, disappointed but able to plan his actual journey. Yue wrote the inspection boundary inside her field cover. She disliked beginning a promising occupation with a list of things she could not promise.

career_survey_bench_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_bench_01.text: On the first morning, the access attendant walked the upper public section and confirmed the day's marked working strip. The clearance concerned ordinary feet and measuring equipment there, under a stop rule for renewed rain. The lower store and closed arch remained outside it. A carrier brought the office's level staff and two rods to the terrace, receiving two copper for the completed delivery. The cloth supplier received the other two after Yue counted the purchased sheets. She would return borrowed instruments. The cloth could be used; the instruments could not quietly become hers.

career_survey_bench_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_bench_02.text: Yuan placed the staff against a known bench mark and asked Yue to read it before seeing yesterday's figure. Yue's first answer differed by one small division. She changed her stance, checked the foot and repeated the reading. The foot had stood on a loose chip. Removing the chip brought the comparison within the method's allowed range. 'Keep both observations,' Yuan said. 'One tells us what the bank did. The other tells us what your setup did.' Yue made two lines instead of turning the first into an invisible mistake.

career_survey_bench_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_bench_03.text: The disconnected brass reference frame remained on Jiang's separate bench. Today's recorder method used ordinary heights, marked distances and timed observations; it needed no formation command or external fuel. Yue's four earned pairs stayed available for their trained bounded use, but their quietness did not diminish this morning. A gull pecked at the packing cord while she counted the staff divisions again. She thought of the kiln's disappointing bowls: some had taught her because someone had allowed their wrong shapes to remain visible after the firing was over.

career_survey_first_setup_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_first_setup_01.text: The office needed a description of where runoff crossed the accessible walking strip. It had time for one detailed emphasis within the first shift. Yuan offered a moving transect through three marked locations or repeated timed watches at the single busy culvert mouth. The ordinary safety observer would remain on duty either way. A transect could compare different low points; a station could preserve the order of a local surge. Neither would produce an entire watershed model. Yue looked at the empty sheet and discovered that a new career began with choosing what it would leave unmeasured.

career_survey_first_method_choice.speaker: narrator
career_survey_first_method_choice.text: One morning could support one careful emphasis. Walking the marked transect would give the maintenance planner spatial comparisons, while a timed culvert watch would give the attendant a local sequence to test. Both methods were supervised and available without an attribute gate. The other detail would wait for an ordinary future survey request. Yue would receive the same shift wage for completed work, and no growth for merely selecting its form. Yuan waited without placing her thumb beside the answer she preferred.

choices.text: Record three upper-walk locations, preserving the distance between low points.
Watch the accessible culvert mouth at repeated times, preserving one local surge sequence.

career_survey_transect_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_transect_01.text: Yue carried the staff to the first marked stop while Yuan watched from the same permitted strip. The bank smelled of flattened mint. At the second stop, a laundry worker pointed to a dark stain and called it the water's highest reach. Yue marked the stain as offered testimony, then measured today's water separately. The worker frowned at the two lines. Her wet blanket had been real; so had her hurried memory. Yue explained that measuring one did not require refusing the other. The worker stayed long enough to show where she had stood.

career_survey_transect_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_transect_02.text: Between the second and third stops, an ordinary rut dipped across the public path. Yuan had Yue measure its endpoints before writing that water flowed through it. They had seen damp soil, not a moving stream. A cart driver argued that every local child knew the rut carried runoff. Yue asked him for its last observed time and recorded his answer with his permission. She wanted knowledge sturdy enough to travel beyond this town. It required treating the driver's long experience as a source with conditions, instead of borrowing his certainty as her own.

career_survey_transect_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_transect_03.text: At the third stop, the staff base sank into soft silt. Yue reset on the approved firmer pad and kept the altered position visible. Yuan returned to the original bench mark for a closing comparison. Their start and finish agreed within tolerance, with the silt reading excluded from the height calculation and retained in the notes. Yue's shoulders hurt from carrying the staff. The work looked shorter on the sheet than it had felt along the path. She resisted adding unnecessary observations merely to make fatigue resemble a more impressive result.

career_survey_transect_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_transect_04.text: Back on the terrace, Yue drew the three locations at their measured separation. The low rut mattered because it lay between a washing approach and the staffed culvert, rather than because any wet mark proved a current danger. She left the local surge sequence unobserved. Yuan asked her which maintenance question the map could support. 'Where to inspect before scheduling surface work,' Yue answered. 'It cannot tell the attendant how quickly one pulse rises.' Saying the missing part aloud made her picture more useful and less satisfying to admire.

career_survey_transect_05.speaker: narrator
career_survey_transect_05.text: The planner accepted the spatial comparison for a later surface inspection request, keeping the testimony apart from measured heights. The request reserved no repair crew and reopened no road. The laundry worker received a permitted copy of her own offered statement and laughed at Yue's painstaking drawing of the crooked approach. 'That bend is where everybody drops a peg,' she said. Yue had measured a place people used, rather than an elegant line between anonymous points. Her first completed field emphasis now had a particular reader and a limitation that reader understood.

career_survey_station_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_station_01.text: Yue set the first watch time beside the culvert's accessible upper mouth. The attendant continued the ordinary safety watch; Yue's training would not replace it. A child waiting with his father counted every leaf that entered the grating. Yue almost copied the count as debris volume, then noticed that one broad leaf and one stem occupied different openings. She recorded visible obstruction by the agreed categories instead. The father moved their basket when the attendant asked. People obeyed a present warning while a future recorder worked out how to describe its conditions.

career_survey_station_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_station_02.text: At the second watch, the flow climbed one marked division and then fell. Yue reached for the earlier average, embarrassed that she had glanced away during the beginning of the change. Yuan asked for the actual interval. They could give a first-seen time, a peak time and a later reduction; they could not recover an unobserved beginning from Yue's wishes. She wrote the missing span. The child said the water had jumped when somebody tipped a bucket upstream. That possibility joined the field note as an unverified explanation, without turning a small pulse into a catchment-wide storm.

career_survey_station_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_station_03.text: The attendant checked the approved upstream maintenance log and found a timed channel rinse. Its entry overlapped the observed rise but did not establish every drop's origin. Yue compared the two clocks against the terrace bell, keeping their difference on the sheet. A tidy timeline would have hidden the small uncertainty. She wondered whether future employers would prefer tidy work. Yuan told her that a planner who punished a truthful interval would be buying a decorative account. Yue wanted employment badly enough to hear the warning as an actual cost, instead of a slogan.

career_survey_station_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_station_04.text: By the third watch, the visible grating obstruction had increased without a higher water mark. Yue wrote both facts. The attendant used the already approved ordinary clearing procedure after checking the strip again; neither the training sheet nor Yue's cultivation authorized entry into the culvert. She watched from the terrace as a worker lifted the accessible loose litter with a hooked pole. The surface changed after clearing. The observation sequence would let the next attendant compare similar episodes, though it gave the maintenance planner no measured separation between the upper walk's other low points.

career_survey_station_05.speaker: narrator
career_survey_station_05.text: The attendant accepted a copy of the timed sequence for the next authorized local watch, including the clock difference and missing beginning. No new alarm threshold was invented from one morning. The child asked whether his leaf count had been wrong. Yue showed him the narrow place where it remained useful: a note of what he had actually seen while she was watching a mark. He looked relieved and then asked for the pencil. She lent it within reach. Useful participation felt better than appointing him a witness to something neither of them could prove.

career_survey_first_receiving_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_first_receiving_01.text: Yuan checked the returned staff and the completed hours against the first ticket. The cashier counted four copper into Yue's palm and two into Yuan's for that morning's supervision. Yue had expected a training wage to feel like a generous advance. It felt like payment for time somebody had needed her to spend. She could buy a meal without explaining her realm, and keep the coins left over without declaring them a sacred sign. Her shift record named the actual chosen emphasis. The unperformed alternative did not appear under accomplishments.

career_survey_first_paid_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_first_paid_01.text: The first supervised shift closed with its checked setup, field emphasis and receiving. Yuan accepted Yue's distinction between measurement and offered explanation. Completed observation practice earned one Comprehension point, with the first paid ticket retained beside the actual work. No pair opened and no appointment widened. The office still needed two further shifts and an independent review before it could qualify her as a recorder. Yue pressed the cloth cover flat with both palms. For once she did not want a beginning to masquerade as the whole occupation.

career_survey_first_evening_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_first_evening_01.text: At the terrace meal stall, Yuan chose the cheapest hot dish and added a second bun from her own wage. Yue asked whether she ever wished she had gone to a larger town. Yuan answered that she sometimes wished it on days when the mill broke and sometimes regretted imagining a life where nobody knew which channel she had maintained. She did not turn that into advice. Yue counted her remaining coins under the table. A paid career might let her help her mother; it might also take her farther from the stove where help was actually needed.

career_survey_second_open_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_open_01.text: On the second morning the upper strip passed its ordinary access check again. A stop notice still covered the lower approaches, where silt hid broken edges. Yuan brought two copies of the drainage sketch: an older operating outline and Yue's fresh blank. The office wanted an observed height comparison beside the feeder channel, not a legal boundary plan. A neighboring plot holder came to watch because he feared the council would put a drain through his garden. Yue could describe surface conditions from permitted public positions. His land and any future work permission remained his own.

career_survey_second_setup_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_setup_01.text: Yue recognized a brass nail in the accessible stone ledge and assumed it was the sketch's old datum. Its position looked right; the letters beside it were worn. Yuan was helping the attendant confirm the permitted end of the strip. Rather than wait for the returning explanation, Yue began her comparison from the nail. She wanted to demonstrate initiative. The plot holder watched her read the staff and asked whether the new sheet would follow the older one. 'I am checking it,' she said, and heard her own answer sound more finished than her work.

career_survey_second_error_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_error_01.text: Yue entered new feeder observations against the brass nail, then compared them with the outfall height copied from the older sketch. The feeder appeared below that recorded outfall, suggesting uphill flow where she saw water travelling downhill. She checked her addition and obtained the same impossible relation. A more dramatic explanation suggested itself: perhaps an old buried formation was doing what the water could not. She had no evidence of one. She left that attractive story unwritten and called Yuan back.

career_survey_second_error_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_error_02.text: Yuan asked her to point to the source identifying the nail. Yue pointed to the ledge instead. The answer was physically clear and evidentially empty. The older outline used a marked coping stone farther along the accessible strip; the nail dated from a later handrail adjustment. They had different reference heights. Yue felt heat behind her ears while the plot holder studied the elegant wrong sketch. She wanted Yuan to take it away quietly. 'This is my setup error,' she said. The words sounded blunt because she had stopped trying to make them impressive.

career_survey_second_error_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_error_03.text: The plot holder asked whether the council had already seen the wrong heights. They had not left the supervised field cover, so Yuan marked the sheet failed before any receiving. He wanted it torn up anyway. Yue explained that its retained failure would prevent the old calculation from reappearing as an unexplained alternative. He asked for a visible note that it supplied no basis for work on his garden. Yuan added that limit. Keeping an error did not require making someone live under it. The plot holder relaxed enough to move his basket out of the measuring line.

career_survey_second_pause_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_pause_01.text: They sat on the dry terrace step while the access attendant continued ordinary checks. Yue's stomach cramped with the shame of having been fast at exactly the wrong moment. Yuan gave her water from their purchased meal supply. 'You found the contradiction before receiving,' she said. 'That helps. It does not make the setup right.' Yue could bear either sentence alone more easily than both together. The shift still had room for remediation; she was allowed to spend its remaining hours learning rather than perform confidence until the cashier's bell.

career_survey_second_remedy_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_remedy_01.text: Before resetting any equipment, Yue wrote the old datum's identifier, its physical location and the source that defined it. Yuan checked the correspondence against the operating outline. They measured between the marked coping and the suspect nail from approved positions, producing a separate comparison rather than changing the old source. The mismatch explained the wrong offset. It did not explain every alteration to the channel over the intervening years. Yue drew the nail in the failed sheet's margin. A small unearned assumption had acquired a shape she could recognize next time.

career_survey_second_remedy_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_remedy_02.text: The staff's carrying strap had slipped while they moved between permitted stops. Yue noticed how much harder she was gripping it to hide fatigue. She asked for the scheduled rest and reset the strap before the next observation. Yuan approved the ordinary pause, keeping its times on their shared work record. There was no trial of heroic endurance in the contract. The useful question was whether Yue could keep a repeated physical method stable across an actual paid morning. She counted her breathing until her hands stopped trying to squeeze embarrassment out through the wood.

career_survey_second_remedy_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_remedy_03.text: With the correct reference identified, they repeated the feeder observations in reverse order. The outfall now fell within the expected ordinary direction, but the middle range differed slightly from the first new series. Yue inspected the marked staff base instead of averaging until the difference vanished. A reed root had kept it from seating flat. She reset within the same allowed pad and repeated that observation. The corrected series agreed within tolerance. Today had supplied two different setup mistakes, neither requiring a hidden force to explain why careful people could obtain an incorrect line.

career_survey_second_remedy_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_remedy_04.text: Yuan read the new field sequence back while Yue checked each location. Their receiving copy distinguished the failed nail-based calculation, the identified datum comparison and the repeated usable series. The plot holder watched Yue write that no observation granted entry or construction rights over his land. He said the old garden wall had shifted once after heavy rain. She offered to record his permitted account for a separate request. He declined for now. His caution did not become proof of concealment. She left a space for a future reply without writing one for him.

career_survey_second_remedy_05.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_remedy_05.text: The maintenance receiver could now compare the feeder's accessible observed heights without inheriting Yue's first assumed origin. He asked whether the record established the drain's full hidden course. It did not. Yuan explained that an authorized underground inspection would need its own equipment and access. Yue recognized the impulse to offer another unpaid afternoon immediately, as if extra hours could atone for the failed sheet. Instead she stated what a future request would have to fund. The receiver accepted the current bounded record and kept the additional question open.

career_survey_second_receiving_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_receiving_01.text: When the shift closed, the cashier paid Yue four copper and Yuan two for the completed supervised hours and included remediation. Neither payment certified the failed calculation. The trainee ledger retained it as failed, followed by the usable repeat. Yue asked whether the word would follow her to another employer. Yuan said a qualified recorder would need to show how she had corrected it. Someone who demanded a history without failure was asking for something less useful than honesty. Yue put the coins beside the cover and wondered whether she was brave enough to apply anywhere that could read it.

career_survey_second_paid_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_paid_01.text: Yuan accepted the completed physical repeat, including the scheduled rest, firm staff seating and reversed check. The performed remediation earned one Physique point. It followed the corrected work and would be recorded once. Yue's fifth-stage four pairs remained unchanged, and her failed original remained part of the training evidence. She had been paid eight copper across two actual shifts, not qualified early by receiving wages. The final field morning would ask whether she could give someone else a record they could use after she stepped away from the staff.

career_survey_second_evening_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_second_evening_01.text: Rain tapped the terrace awning after their instruments had gone into the office's locked rack. Yue wrote a letter to her mother on the back of an unused meal wrapper. She described the pay and the error without adding a promise to send money she had not yet set aside. Her mother might worry more after learning that mistakes could follow a person into employment. Yue crossed out a reassuring sentence about guaranteed work. The remaining letter said that the people training her had required a correction and stayed while she made it.

career_survey_third_open_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_open_01.text: The third shift began late because the access attendant waited for overnight runoff to settle before opening the upper strip. The paid ticket covered the agreed working hours from actual opening; the crew had never been instructed to enter at a clock time regardless of conditions. Yuan showed Yue the fresh access limit before handing over the staff. Two local workers had asked for a usable drainage note at their washing approach. The office also needed a clean handover for the next recorder. Yue would have to complete both within the same ordinary field interval.

career_survey_third_setup_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_setup_01.text: A washing worker wanted the notice to say that the approach was safe. She had missed paid hours on the lower route and needed customers to return. Yue understood the request more closely now that she had a wage of her own. The record could report observed conditions on the permitted upper strip at named times; the attendant held its access decision. It could not certify a whole season. The worker stared at the proposed wording and said customers might read it as doubt. Yue admitted that some would, while others needed its date to make a real choice.

career_survey_third_setup_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_setup_02.text: Yuan asked Yue to hand the second rod to a relief observer and explain the method without touching it. Yue began with the height she expected, then stopped herself. An expected result could pull a new reader's eye toward the desired division. She started again with the reference, staff seating, sight line and permitted range. The observer obtained a different first reading because the rod faced backward. Yue let her turn it and repeat. Teaching made Yue's own hurry visible in another person's hands, where it could be corrected without confusing urgency with skill.

career_survey_third_handover_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_handover_01.text: At the washing approach, the two observers recorded a damp ledge and an unobstructed surface outfall. They could not see the hidden pipe beyond it. The washing worker offered yesterday's memory of a brief overflow and permitted her account to appear without her household details. Yue copied the time range she supplied. A second worker disputed that range, saying the light had already changed. Rather than force one neat event between them, Yue wrote two offered accounts and today's distinct observation. The workers continued arguing about the afternoon, but neither accused her of changing their words.

career_survey_third_handover_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_handover_02.text: The relief observer found an ambiguous abbreviation on Yue's earlier trial copy. It could mean the upper rail or the upper reed mark. Yue had known which one she intended, and that knowledge had concealed the problem. She replaced the abbreviation on the usable copy with the full location and marked the correction against its source. Yuan did not ask her to rewrite every page into beautiful handwriting. The test was whether another person could find the same point without Yue supplying forgotten instructions from her memory. Her ambition suddenly had to fit inside somebody else's ordinary working morning.

career_survey_third_handover_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_handover_03.text: They returned to the terrace for the last comparison. Yue gave the relief observer the record and stepped back with Yuan. The observer identified the datum, repeated the accessible check and named the hidden section as unobserved. A washer asked again whether the record meant customers could stop worrying. The observer directed her to the staffed access notice and explained its conditions in familiar words. Yue felt a small, disorienting pride: the useful answer had travelled without needing her face beside it. She had helped make herself temporarily unnecessary to one narrow piece of work.

career_survey_third_receiving_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_receiving_01.text: The office received the completed field record, the usable handover and the two separate offered accounts. The third shift ended with four copper paid to Yue and two to Yuan. That settled all twelve copper of Yue's training wages and all six of supervision. The cashier did not release the specialist allowance; the review still lay ahead. Yue divided her actual coins between travel, meals and a small household remittance through the ordinary service. The remittance bought no cure for her mother's damaged route. It could buy less tiring groceries this week.

career_survey_third_paid_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_third_paid_01.text: Yuan accepted the third shift's finished handover and Yue's refusal to turn observed access into a season-long assurance. The completed responsibility practice earned one Dao Heart point. Choosing the career had granted nothing; three performed shifts had now produced three bounded gains, separately saved. Yue still needed an independent practical review. She put the wage tickets behind the failed and corrected sheets instead of hiding the failure at the bottom. A career could be built from that sequence if someone else could examine it without relying on how sincerely she wanted to deserve it.

career_survey_review_open_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_open_01.text: Jiang arrived for the independent practical review after the three supervised shifts had closed. His fixed fee came from the separate examination line; he had no bonus for approving a new employee and had not chosen Yue's field answers. Yuan handed over the retained records, including the failed datum calculation. A local witness checked the appointment and observed the review. Her two-copper fee paid for that attendance, not technical approval. Yue watched Jiang lay her neat and untidy sheets beside one another. The failure occupied more space than she remembered allowing it.

career_survey_review_open_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_open_02.text: The practical question was narrow: could Yue produce an attributable ordinary observation record from an approved position, identify its reference and limits, and hand it to another worker? Jiang would not confer bridge inspection rights, medical practice or authority to settle another person's ownership. He asked her to describe those limits in her own words before touching the staff. Yue found it harder to speak them to a man who might employ her later. She wanted him to see how much she could do. She told him where she had to stop first.

career_survey_review_field_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_field_01.text: The access attendant permitted the same dry upper check position after that morning's ordinary inspection. Jiang supplied an unfamiliar source label, then asked Yue to locate its actual mark rather than repeat the previous day's route. She found two nearby painted lines and traced the source wording before choosing. One line had no identifying number. She recorded it as a neighboring mark instead of the reference. Jiang said nothing. The witness kept her eyes on the positions and times, leaving the technical answer to the appointed examiner.

career_survey_review_field_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_field_02.text: Yue checked the staff foot, took the prescribed observations and closed against the reference. A gust stirred the cloth at the last reading. She paused until it settled and recorded the pause instead of treating the fluttering range as usable. Her hands remembered yesterday's overgripping. This time she noticed before the wood began to shake. The relief observer waited beside the terrace rail to receive the account. Yue's work would not become correct because she felt calmer; it would become usable if its actual repetition and conditions survived somebody else's attempt to read them.

career_survey_review_handover_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_handover_01.text: She gave the finished record to the relief observer without pointing at the staff. The observer identified the reference, repeated the check from the permitted position and named the pause. Jiang asked what the figures implied about the closed bridge. Yue answered that this check measured an accessible channel position and had no structural bearing on the arch. The observer could reproduce the observed range within tolerance. The witness confirmed who had held the staff and who had read it. A quiet agreement between instruments and people felt less spectacular than the examination Yue had once imagined.

career_survey_review_failure_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_failure_01.text: Jiang returned to the failed field sheet and asked why Yue had believed the brass nail. She said she recognized its location and wanted to be quick. She did not call the old drawing deceptive or the neighboring owner difficult. 'What would you do if the next shift's opening delay left no time to repeat?' he asked. 'Receive the incomplete observations as incomplete, or stop the task,' she answered. An employer could dislike that answer. Giving it to an examiner before she had a job made her feel the actual edge of the commitment.

career_survey_review_scope_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_scope_01.text: The examiner accepted the practical check and the explanation of the retained failure. His signed recommendation qualified Yue for a bounded survey-recorder appointment: ordinary observations on authorized sites using an approved method, source attribution, correction trails and handover. A site lead would still set access and methods; specialists would interpret structural and clinical questions. Jiang did not promise permanent employment or an independent surveyor's license. Yue read the occupation title twice. It was smaller than the work she dreamed of doing and substantially larger than a hope she had never had to prove.

career_survey_review_pass_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_pass_01.text: The watershed office accepted the witnessed recommendation and entered Yue's bounded recorder qualification. Jiang received his three-copper fee; the local witness received two for completed attendance. Qualification followed the checked practical work and independent judgment. It did not erase the failed sheet, change her wages retrospectively or raise cultivation beyond the retained fifth stage. Yue had permission to take one further funded recorder assignment under a site lead. Later employment would require an actual offer. The office stamp landed beside the limits, making them part of what the stamp said rather than fine print beneath a triumph.

career_survey_review_method_gate.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_method_gate.text: Before the office offered its final assignment, the receiver checked which first-shift emphasis Yue had actually completed. Its available record could support a corresponding ordinary follow-up; a missing saved decision would support neither selected follow-up by assumption. Yue waited while the receiver opened the attributable field cover. The same qualification could grow out of different mornings and leave different people with useful evidence. Being qualified did not make her earlier choice interchangeable. The unobserved part of that first morning still required its own future time and money.

career_survey_review_transect_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_transect_01.text: The maintenance planner had used Yue's three-point comparison to place a surface inspection request on the ordinary schedule. No crew had yet cut the rut or entered the neighboring garden. The washing worker received its date and could ask the planner how any proposed work would affect her approach. She told Yue that a scheduled question was better than a rumor and worse than a repaired path. The local culvert's surge sequence remained unmeasured by Yue's shift. Its attendant continued the existing watch rather than inheriting a timeline from an unused alternative.

career_survey_review_transect_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_transect_02.text: Yuan showed Yue the planner's received request, which named the actual public positions and preserved the withheld private-land permission. The laundry worker had added a practical suggestion about where a temporary peg rail could stand during an inspection. It was her proposal, awaiting approval, not a benefit Yue could promise. Yue wanted to pursue surface drainage work because the spatial map had connected her calculations to that awkward bend. The first method had given her an interest she could test further, without forcing her next career decision to repeat it.

career_survey_review_station_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_station_01.text: The culvert attendant had compared Yue's timed record during another authorized local watch. He found that the recorded maintenance rinse offered a useful clock comparison but did not reproduce the missing beginning of the earlier rise. He kept the ordinary alert procedure unchanged and requested another observed sequence before proposing any revision. The father and child returned with a basket and heard that specific answer. The upper walk's separate low points still had no spatial comparison from Yue's first shift. The maintenance planner would need its own future survey before scheduling from those distances.

career_survey_review_station_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_review_station_02.text: Yuan read the attendant's received follow-up to Yue. The child had asked to help again; his father permitted a short observation from the staffed terrace, with the attendant retaining responsibility. Yue had wanted to be useful in ways that could survive her absence. Here the surviving result was another careful question, accompanied by a family willing to notice its conditions. She felt drawn toward observation notices, where a small timing error could change somebody's day. That interest did not appoint her to the warning service or determine her next funded task.

career_survey_specialization_setup_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_specialization_setup_01.text: Three copper remained reserved for one completed specialist assignment by the newly qualified recorder. One request concerned a surface-drainage handover for the maintenance planner; the other concerned a local observation notice for the staffed upper walk. Both used ordinary observations inside the permitted site and required receiving by the actual responsible lead. Neither would appoint Yue to decide construction, crossing access or clinical care. The requests competed for the same final work interval. She could develop one practice now, then seek future funded work for the other instead of silently volunteering the unpaid hours.

career_survey_specialization_choice.speaker: narrator
career_survey_specialization_choice.text: The drainage handover would help a later inspection crew locate permitted surface points and would leave individual notice work to the ordinary staff. The observation notice would help current users understand one watched location and would leave the detailed maintenance handover for a later recorder. Both tasks were open to Yue's bounded qualification. The office would pay three copper only after the selected service was received. Neither preference carried an immediate attribute gain or a promise of permanent work. Yue could want both futures while accepting one actual assignment.

choices.text: Develop surface-drainage recording through a usable maintenance handover.
Develop observation communication through a received local condition notice.

career_survey_drainage_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_01.text: Yue accepted the surface-drainage handover ticket. The ordinary maintenance site lead supplied the approved recording method and the same checked upper working strip; the ticket hired no entry into private land or hidden pipes. Yuan had returned to her mill shift and its own keys. Yue missed the comfort of having her field supervisor close enough to catch an assumption. She opened the usable training sequence, then put its first failed sheet where she would see it before selecting a datum. Qualification let her work within a method. It did not replace the method with confidence.

career_survey_drainage_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_02.text: The lead asked for three clearly located surface observations and an account of what a following inspection would still need to establish. Yue chose approved points that a crew carrying ordinary equipment could actually find. She recorded the present reference identifier before reading a staff division. At the far point, a patched reed screen obscured the sight line. Instead of leaning outside the marked strip, she used the allowed alternate position and documented its offset. Her sheet would carry a more cumbersome calculation. The next recorder would also know why that calculation existed.

career_survey_drainage_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_03.text: A worker from the maintenance crew offered to draw a straight arrow through the neighboring garden so the handover would look clear. Yue kept the public observations connected within their permitted scope and marked the unseen section as a proposed investigation. The plot holder had given no construction or entry permission. The worker complained that this would slow planning. She agreed and recorded the actual request the lead would need to make. His impatience was understandable. Turning it into an apparent surveyed route would have transferred the delay to someone who had never accepted the work.

career_survey_drainage_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_04.text: Back at the terrace, the maintenance worker tried to locate each point from Yue's handover. He found two and missed the third because her description relied on a movable drying rack. She changed the location description to fixed public marks and retained the correction. They repeated the third identification successfully. The service had included this receiving test within its fixed interval; no extra allowance appeared. Yue wanted to call the corrected description obvious once it worked. Remembering the failed rack reference stopped her. A recorder's clarity could be earned after discovering the point where another person had become lost.

career_survey_drainage_05.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_05.text: The site lead accepted the attributable surface record and usable handover for an ordinary future inspection. She reserved the hidden section and any garden entry for separate authorization. Yue submitted the ticket against its completed deliverable, with the failed location description and correction still traceable. Individual notices to washing customers remained ordinary staff work beyond this task. She had made planning easier for a crew without promising that easier planning would produce repairs. The worker folded his readable copy carefully. That small action felt like receiving a tool she had made with words and heights.

career_survey_warning_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_01.text: Yue accepted the local observation-notice ticket. The staffed upper-walk service gave her its approved wording method, current access conditions and a permitted observation position. Its regular lead kept authority over openings and warnings. Yuan had returned to her mill duty; Yue now had to use her qualification without asking her former supervisor to carry another shift invisibly. The task hired a received explanation of this watched location, not a new danger threshold. She checked the existing board's date. An accurate sentence left past its date could mislead more effectively than a badly written one.

career_survey_warning_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_02.text: At the terrace rail, Yue took the allowed observations under the ordinary attendant's watch. Two waiting washers asked whether a damp mark meant they could move their baskets lower. She pointed to the staffed access limit and recorded the mark's actual position without interpreting it as an opening. One washer said the official notice was too hard to understand. Yue asked which part she would use when deciding whether to carry a basket here. The answer concerned the approach's operating hours and a contact for changes. She copied those practical needs before writing the new explanation.

career_survey_warning_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_03.text: Her first draft began with the measured range. A waiting reader interpreted it as a promise that tomorrow's range would be the same. Yue changed the opening to the observed date and location, followed by the source for current access. The range remained available beneath that explanation. Another reader asked whether a missing observation meant the service had failed to watch. She distinguished the recorder's short assignment from the attendant's continuing duty. The notice would name its own interval. It would not make regular workers disappear simply because their work had not become part of Yue's training book.

career_survey_warning_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_04.text: The service lead read the notice aloud at the ordinary staffed board, then asked two willing readers to explain what it would let them decide. They found the current contact, date and location; they disagreed about how a later change would be posted. Yue added the actual board and service hours rather than a vague promise of updates. The two readers gave permission for their wording comments to be kept without household details. The notice's technical figures remained unchanged. A more usable sentence had emerged through checking, not through making the measured water sound less uncertain.

career_survey_warning_05.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_05.text: The service lead accepted the corrected observation notice and posted it within the existing staff procedure. Her regular duty covered keeping or replacing it under that procedure; Yue's finite contract did not create unpaid attendance for the readers. The detailed maintenance handover remained an ordinary future request. Yue submitted the completed ticket with the first misleading draft and its correction attached. A washer carried her basket along the permitted upper approach after asking the attendant for today's decision. The notice had helped her find the right question and the right person, rather than making Yue that person.

career_survey_specialist_receiving_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_specialist_receiving_01.text: At the office's ordinary receiving desk, the clerk checked the actual specialist ticket against its delivered record and named receiving lead. A qualification card alone could not draw the three-copper allowance. The work had to be attributable, corrected where necessary and accepted within the funded scope. Yue watched the clerk compare the final copy with its earlier draft. This was familiar enough to feel like a career rather than an examination. It was also the place where a mistake could still stop payment pending correction instead of turning an approved budget into money somebody already possessed.

career_survey_specialist_receiving_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_specialist_receiving_02.text: The receiver found the service complete under its actual ticket and entered the accepted finishing time. He did not turn that result into a standing appointment. The office kept the recorder's corrected source chain and returned the borrowable instruments against their inventory; the remaining purchased cloth stayed in the office's record stock. Yue asked when the next post would be advertised. Its funding decision was not yet made. She wrote the ordinary application contact instead of a promised date. Future employment could matter enough to ask about without becoming a wage already due.

career_survey_specialist_result_gate.speaker: narrator
career_survey_specialist_result_gate.text: The office sent the completed specialist record to the responsible ordinary service. Its later use would follow the saved assignment that Yue had actually accepted. A missing commitment record would support neither particular consequence by inference; the common close would retain the training and qualification without claiming a specialist result. Yue waited at the terrace while the service checked its own receiving. The final coin mattered to her. So did finding out whether the work would help somebody after its author's paid interval had ended.

career_survey_drainage_outcome_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_outcome_01.text: Two days later, an inspection crew used Yue's surface handover to identify the approved public points without asking her to lead them. The fixed third-point description held after the drying rack moved. At the garden boundary, the crew stopped and issued its separate permission request. The plot holder saw that stop and agreed to discuss a future appointment; he had not yet granted entry. The handover saved searching time and preserved a negotiation. It did not discover the hidden pipe by description alone or give the crew a route through a man who was still deciding.

career_survey_drainage_outcome_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_outcome_02.text: The maintenance lead received the crew's surface inspection note and compared its observations with Yue's dated record. A small height change warranted a new ordinary check before proposing work. The lead placed that check in the maintenance queue and kept the bridge question entirely separate. The washing workers still needed individual explanations from the staffed approach service. Yue heard one complain that a map could be useful to everyone except the person trying to earn today's washing wage. She listened, knowing that she had selected the handover and left that communication task for another funded interval.

career_survey_drainage_outcome_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_outcome_03.text: The crew's worker returned Yue's readable copy to the office and said he wanted the same style on a future surface job. The office had no approved vacancy to offer, so his preference entered a reference about completed work rather than a hiring promise. Yue asked him to describe the fixed-point correction as well as the successful use. He laughed at her severity, then agreed. She would apply for surface-drainage recorder work using this bounded sample. Her next employer could see both how the crew had used it and why it had needed correction first.

career_survey_drainage_outcome_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_outcome_04.text: At the payment desk, the clerk checked the specialist service's accepted receiving and released its three copper to Yue. Her actual pay from this contract now totaled fifteen: twelve for three supervised shifts and three for the completed handover assignment. Thirty copper had been spent across the separate training budget's performed wages, supervision, examination, attendance, supplies and carrying. No reserve remained to fund the unchosen notice task. The maintenance service kept its future work queue, and the upper-walk staff kept its ordinary communication duty. Yue folded the paid ticket around neither of those future responsibilities.

career_survey_drainage_paid_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_drainage_paid_01.text: The received drainage handover and its checked later use completed Yue's first qualified specialist practice. It earned one Comprehension point after the work, recorded once at this passage. The planner had usable public surface locations; private permission, hidden-course investigation and any repair remained separate questions. The local notice specialty stayed unperformed by this ticket. Yue's fifth stage retained four pairs. She had acquired a demonstrated practice and a possible employment reference, with fifteen copper actually paid and no permanent post yet promised. That was enough to put this career honestly on her next application.

career_survey_warning_outcome_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_outcome_01.text: Two days later, the staffed service replaced the observed notice when its interval had passed, retaining Yue's dated copy with the ordinary log. A washer arrived after the replacement and asked for the current contact instead of relying on the old figures. She learned of a shorter opening window and arranged her paid work accordingly. The service had made the access decision; the notice's tested wording had helped her locate it. Yue saw a practical result she could describe without claiming to have made the approach safer by writing about it.

career_survey_warning_outcome_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_outcome_02.text: The father from the first morning read the new board to his child, who asked why yesterday's figures had disappeared. The attendant showed the dates on the retained copies and explained that observations could be true for their intervals without being tomorrow's instructions. Yue watched from the permitted rail. The detailed surface handover remained unfinished by her contract, and the maintenance planner still needed a future recorder to make it. One clear notice had changed how a family read an update. It had not measured the route that another crew would eventually need.

career_survey_warning_outcome_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_outcome_03.text: The service lead asked the office to keep Yue's corrected draft as an example for later notice assignments. The request named a completed skill and carried no appointment. Its ordinary roster remained with the existing attendants; the next recorder contract would require funding. Yue asked for a work reference and received one describing the dated explanation, reader check and corrected ambiguity. She would apply for observation-communication jobs with that actual evidence. The washers did not need to become admirers of her cultivation for their comments to have helped build the qualification she could now show.

career_survey_warning_outcome_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_outcome_04.text: At the payment desk, the clerk checked the specialist service's accepted receiving and released its three copper to Yue. Her actual pay from the contract now totaled fifteen: twelve for three supervised shifts and three for the completed notice assignment. Thirty copper had been spent across the separate budget's performed wages, supervision, examination, attendance, supplies and carrying. No reserve remained to hire the unchosen drainage handover. The maintenance planner kept that future request in its ordinary queue. Yue could value the notice's present readers and still understand why a crew wanted a different record.

career_survey_warning_paid_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_warning_paid_01.text: The received local observation notice and its checked later use completed Yue's first qualified specialist practice. It earned one Dao Heart point after the work, recorded once at this passage. Readers had a tested way to find current information and its actual responsible service. Access decisions, future maintenance measurements and structural judgments retained their own authorities. Yue's fifth stage retained four pairs. The drainage specialty stayed unperformed by this ticket. Fifteen copper had actually reached her hands, and a work reference described what she had accomplished without offering a permanent job the office could not yet fund.

career_survey_final_01.speaker: narrator
career_survey_final_01.text: Yue returned the staff to its inventoried rack and kept her permitted qualification copy, paid tickets and the work evidence available to her actual journey. The office retained its sources and the failed field calculation with its correction. A missing specialist commitment would leave the last allowance unclaimed pending evidence or returned to its ordinary account; the qualification and three paid training shifts stood on their own completed records. She did not use a blank future line to describe employment she had never accepted. The bridge outside still needed its separate structural process.

career_survey_final_02.speaker: narrator
career_survey_final_02.text: Yuan came past after her mill shift and asked how the independent review had felt. Yue said she had wanted Jiang to see everything she might eventually become. He had asked what somebody else could use today. Yuan grinned, then leaned against the rail without offering to carry Yue's staff anymore. The change hurt for a moment. It also gave Yue room to hold the completed work herself. They watched an ordinary carrier take the upper public path, using the attendant's current opening rather than either woman's remembered certainty.

career_survey_final_03.speaker: narrator
career_survey_final_03.text: Jiang stopped at the terrace to collect his own disconnected frame. The recorder qualification gave Yue no claim to that equipment. She helped him count its inventoried pieces before it went into his case. He asked what she intended to study next. She answered with the practice she had actually completed and an application she could make, leaving room for other work later. He said a recorder who respected ordinary methods could still cultivate ambitiously. That encouragement made no sixth pair appear. It let ambition sit beside the dry staff rack without treating the rack as a lesser life.

career_survey_final_04.speaker: narrator
career_survey_final_04.text: Before leaving, Yue read the earlier flood account once more. This training had not carried another crate during the storm, restored lost annotations or converted a later supply circuit into an earlier rescue. People affected by her first cargo and recovery choices still had their separate gains and delays. The new paid career made her better equipped to record what came next. It could not make her less responsible for yesterday by teaching her new words for it. She put the two covers side by side, then packed them without letting either one replace the other.

career_survey_final_05.speaker: narrator
career_survey_final_05.text: At the upper-road turn, Yue looked back at the terrace where she had first mistaken a trainee title for an insult. Three supervised shifts, a retained failure, a corrected repeat and an independent witnessed check had made it an honest beginning. Her actual completed work could guide future applications and further funded practice. She carried no ownership of the channel and no promise of an open bridge. She carried usable evidence, actual wages and a qualification with stated limits. The next receiving table would be the first place she could introduce herself with that work behind her.
